patForm.description: Drive the classic Personal Access Token form: open the prefilled URL, set description + expiration through the native input setter, ensure the requested scopes are checked, click Generate, extract the ghp_ token by regex. Stops on a 'Confirm access' sudo re-auth page rather than clicking through it.

expirationLabel.description: visible label to click, default "No expiration"

returns.description: {token} on success; {stop, ...} on sudo / missing scopes / no button / token not found

setOrgAvatar.description: Set an org's avatar via the org profile settings page (no REST/GraphQL endpoint exists for this). Sets the hidden #avatar-upload-input via DOM.setFileInputFiles, then clicks the 'Set new profile picture' button in the crop dialog. dryRun:true stops after locating the input, without uploading.

file.description: absolute path to the image (500x500 PNG verified); required unless dryRun

dryRun.description: stop after finding #avatar-upload-input; do not upload

returns.description: {done:true} on success; {done:false, reason} on no admin access, no input found, or upload/click failure

openFgPat.description: Phase 1 of changing a fine-grained PAT's repository access (no API exists). Opens https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/<tokenId> in a background tab that stays open. At the 'Confirm access' sudo gate it clicks 'Use GitHub Mobile' and returns the two digits for the caller to approve on the phone; never types a password. Call again with the returned targetId to poll until sudo clears (resend:true reloads and sends a fresh phone request after expiry).

tokenId.description: numeric suffix of the token link on /settings/personal-access-tokens

targetId.description: tab from a previous call; re-checks it instead of opening a new one

resend.description: with targetId: reload and click 'Use GitHub Mobile' again

waitMs.description: with targetId: poll up to this long for sudo to clear, default 30000, max 120000

addFgPatRepo.description: Phase 2: add one repository id to a fine-grained PAT's selected repositories. In ONE page evaluation it clicks the second 'Edit' button, then aborts unless install_target=selected is checked, the id is absent, and the current repository_ids[] count equals expectCount; then clones the last hidden input, sets the new id, and fires the form's 'Update' click on a timer. Cannot verify access; the caller checks with the token itself.

targetId.description: tab from openFgPat once its status is 'ready'

org.description: org login in the form action /grant-requests/organizations/<org>

expectCount.description: repositories currently on the token; the verb aborts on any other count

returns.description: {done:true, before, after, targetId} on submit; {done:false, reason, ...} on sudo, wrong page, edit-button-missing, form-not-open, install-target-not-selected, count-mismatch, already-present, no-input-to-clone, update-button-missing
